So I have made it know that Bowser is and always will be my all time favourite skylander of all time for so many reasons. his hammer, his koopa's to even his overall design. everything about Bowser is nigh on perfect to me and there is no amount of anything that could change my mind especially because half of my love for this figure is because I am a massive fan of the big guy just in general but as a skylander with some amazing references in his kit he is a genuine beast to play as. his normal hammer attacks are really fun to do with load of damage, summoning green Koopa's and smacking them to go aimlessly is so cool to do cause it covers a lot of ground and that is before they can go into the red Koopa's which in mario kart fashion HOME in on any enemy it sees like they stole money or something. the Koopa path having them come out the warp pipes and being paratroopers is so cool and helps Boswer more to then turning them into Dry bones every time you use molten form...oh yea speaking of that...MOLTEN FORM IS THE BEST THING EVER AND I LOVE IT. me being me I like to save Molten for the longer winded fights cause of the massive damage both his claw swings and fire breath can dish out and while the bottom path doesn't do an awful lot to molten bowser, lets be real here...it did not need it cause its a beast of a form and a skylanders original form for the King himself. and the clown cruiser having references to his current ship looks to having a dry bone face to even a banzi bill face they packed a lot onto Bowser and it shows how much love they gave to both him and Donkey kong equally. I am glad they are in the series but if you play on non nintendo consoles you won't be able to enjoy them at all which sucks but we shall just have to KEEP SAVING SKYLANDS and hope 1 day Nintendo make them multi platform too aye lol
